text.en:
Effectivity. - The reorganization of the
Peace and Order Council as herein provided shall take effect
Immediately and be completed within thirty (30) days there-
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of November,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-seven.
By the President:
Acting Executive Secretary
